column4: Legacy shared document core, +85 lines for the dark reading theme fused into copy_pixmap_to_bitmap() and the cached per-page image rectangles behind SPDF_RENDER_PRESERVE_IMAGES (the transform itself lives in spdf_recolor.c); freeze growth pending subsystem extraction. Multiline regex rewrite extracted unchanged into spdf_search_regex.h so hit geometry and native snippets share the same matching policy. Bitmap conversion and lazy picture classification extracted to spdf_render_bitmap.h. -52 lines moving the metadata, permission and password accessors to spdf_document_info.h (included in place), paying for the +38 that read a document while it downloads (szpdf: links, spdf_progressive.c behind hooks in spdf_core_document.h, so a frontend that never downloads links nothing new). -321 lines moving the translated-copy line writer to spdf_translate_redact.h (removes the original glyphs, and scan pixels under an OCR layer) and spdf_translate_write.h (lays out and embeds the translation), both included in place, replacing the 95%-white overlay that left the original faintly visible.

Shared strict-YAML-subset state codec (parser + emitter + JSON bridge + flock-guarded migration) serving both frontends, +17 lines for mtime-aware re-migration when a pre-YAML build wrote newer JSON; freeze growth pending parse/emit split.
Legacy GTK annotation controller; freeze growth pending extraction.

GTK application lifecycle is cohesive and platform-specific. -38 lines moving the resident start's first-frame warmup to spdf_resident_warmup.c, paying for the szpdf: link argument (spdf_link_open.c).

Existing private document-view state contract; new state belongs in focused owners.

Cohesive persistence regression suite; +11 lines for the YAML boundary/migration coverage; new scenarios should use focused fixtures.

Existing private coordinator state contract; +3 lines for the YAML state-file migration hook, +6 lines for the persisted Markdown reading theme and its toolbar toggle button, +16 lines for widening that theme to every document (the preserve-images setting plus the single-page render declaration Copy Page Image needs to ask for original colors); new state belongs in focused modules. +15 lines for the SPDFMacLinkNavigation category (instant reversible in-document link following) and the scrollToPage:alignTop: declaration it reuses. -1 line: selectableTextStateForPDFAtPath:errorMessage: is declared by the SPDFMacOCRValidation category that implements it. Removed obsolete context-helper declaration after extraction. -4 lines: the three viewport-page declarations moved to SPDFMacViewportRenderPriority.h with their implementations.

Cohesive AppKit document input and view implementation; rendering primitives live in SPDFMacPageRendering, exact-viewport fit insets in SPDFMacFitGeometry, reading-theme gutter/page-border chrome in SPDFMacDocumentViewTheme. +55 lines for instant in-document link activation on mouse-up and the one-click-run undo snapshot that keeps multi-click word/block selection over link text working.

Cohesive out-of-focus zoom subsystem lifted out of SPDFMacUIHelpers.mm: the HID event tap, its NSEvent-monitor fallback, and the routing of a tapped pinch or Cmd/Ctrl wheel to the view under the cursor. Policy decisions stay pure in SPDFMacWindowChrome.

Cohesive AppKit minimap strip (layout, hit-testing, cached-strip drawing and drag/wheel input share private layout caches); was legacy at 1004. -10 lines moving the reading-theme chrome (gutter, paper fill, page border, placeholder tint) to SPDFMacMinimapViewTheme.mm; -20 lines net moving the find/selection overlay drawing to SPDFMacMinimapViewOverlays.mm, paying for -noteThumbnailLoadedForPage:, which swaps a re-rendered page object into the strip snapshot so a late thumbnail is drawn without a scroll. Next split: input handling.

Mixed AppKit helper views, down from a 1332-line legacy cap: the out-of-focus zoom subsystem moved wholesale to SPDFMacInactiveZoom.mm, then the two custom-drawn toolbar buttons to SPDFMacToolbarButtons.mm. Still mixed, so further additions belong in a focused file, not here. Simplified passive-focus keyboard routing through the shared Find interaction category. Menu symbol construction moved to SPDFMacMenuSymbols; Find Return routing stays at the explicit window event boundary. Pane dividers extracted to SPDFMacPaneDividers for shared symmetric hit/cursor geometry.

Legacy signed updater, -5 lines after the pure download bounds moved to SPDFUpdaterDownloadBounds.mm, -7 lines routing the support-directory lookup through spdf_mac_support_directory() (SPDFMacSupport.mm) so SPDF_STATE_DIR redirects it, -6 lines with the pure Info.plist version reader spdf_running_version_from_info() in SPDFUpdaterRelease.mm; freeze growth pending trust/transport/UI split.

to draw recognised text. -17 more lines moving -selectableTextStateForPDFAtPath:errorMessage: to SPDFMacOCRValidation.mm, which also decides whether an OCR run skipped pages. -28 more lines moving the to SPDFMacOCRValidation.mm as spdf_mac_ocr_human_readable_failure, paying for the retry that takes ocrmypdf's advice when it refuses a file outright. -9 more lines moving -taskEnvironmentWithToolPaths:(extra:) to SPDFMacToolEnvironmentIntegration.mm, which is also where a machine still on its own ocrmypdf or Argos is adopted into the app's virtualenv. -4 more lines moving the two reading-theme View rows to SPDFMacReadingThemeIntegration.mm, which owns the theme they toggle. -40 more lines moving the Argos install offer for selection translation to SPDFMacTranslationInstall.mm, paying for the environment gates on the OCR and translation entry points. -23 more lines moving the ocrmypdf command line to SPDFMacOCRCommand.mm, where the measurement behind each flag can be tested. -8 more lines moving the translation busy guards into beginTranslateCommandForSender:, the gate every Translate entry point already passes through, paying for the Markdown whole-document branch. -24 more lines moving -detachTabAtIndex: to SPDFMacTabDetach.mm, which also hands the tab's reading position to the process the detach launches. -47 lines net moving tab file actions into SPDFMacTabFileActions.mm, paying for lazy group persistence, editor menu, and explicit agent-command routing seams. -130 lines net extracting Collection/search orchestration, with explicit deferred capture, save protection, and observed-change seams. -3 lines using the shared sidebar mode configuration. -2 lines simplifying sidebar availability while wiring the extracted persistent workspace. -4 lines centralizing sidebar availability before workspace routing. -381 lines net extracting command-palette presentation and the compact workspace chrome. -171 lines net extracting compact sidebar Find rendering and viewport fitting to SPDFMacSidebarPresentation, while adding persistent responsive panel routing. -16 lines extracting file-drop routing to SPDFMacFileBrowsing and a shared format policy. Extracted Find keyboard interaction and page-context construction; palette cancellation and per-window title lookup remain explicit. Extracted format-aware Properties routing to SPDFMacPropertiesIntegration. Shortcut-help row rendering extracted to SPDFMacShortcutHelpStyle; OCR image and native translation preparation extracted to SPDFMacDocumentToolInputIntegration. Image Save As routing extracted to SPDFMacImageSaveIntegration, paying for clipboard document routing. Close action extracted to SPDFMacUnsavedImageClose, which owns deferred close approval. Tab-strip event capture extracted to SPDFMacTabEventRouting to enforce fresh-gesture ownership. Read-only render-copy byte authoring and complete provenance validation extracted to SPDFMacReadOnlyCopy; coordinator only applies the main-thread binding and invalidates stale runtime/preloads. Rotation commands extracted to SPDFMacRotationIntegration; image encoding stays in its explicit worker. Fit viewport/scroller preparation extracted to SPDFMacFitViewport.; -1 line iterating document objects directly for palette recency metadata; extract find counter/control status for explicit search failures; extract PDF find execution with explicit publication guard for cancelled or superseded citations; -59 lines net moving -visibleDocumentPageIndexesWithExtraRadius:preferredPage:, -queueVisibleDocumentPageRendersForCurrentViewportForceHighPriority: and -syncCurrentPageFromVisibleViewportQueueRenders:forceHighPriority: to SPDFMacViewportRenderPriority.mm, paying for the calls that render the viewport side by side once an open has painted, after a jump and when a scroll settles; -3 lines routing the four page-render cleanups through spdf_forgetQueuedRenderOperation:page: (SPDFMacViewportRenderPriority.mm), which leaves an entry that a withdrawn operation's replacement already owns; -93 lines net moving the document open path (application:openFile(s):, openPaths:, openPath:, openRecentDocument:) to SPDFMacDocumentOpening.mm, which now brings an opened document's tab forward in its own group and hands a document another window shows to that window; -203 lines moving Cmd+K palette activation (Return, Cmd+Return, row movement, clicks, opening the chosen row, the key monitor, closing, favorite deletion) to SPDFMacPaletteActivation.mm, and the open-document titles to SPDFMacCollectionPalette.mm and SPDFMacPaletteDocumentNames.mm; -21 lines net moving the quit (hide first, then write; SPDFMacQuitFinishing.mm), the read-only edit question (now a writable copy, SPDFMacWritableCopy.mm) and the launch state prefetch (SPDFMacStatePrefetch.mm) out, and replacing two launch dispatch_afters that ran before the first frame with spdf_mac_after_first_paint; -116 lines moving the PDF search list (rebuildSearchSidebarItems, chapterTitleForMatchOnPage:atPagePoint:) to SPDFMacFindExecution.mm, which now searches pages on background workers and fills the list as they finish

Cohesive HTML block-island translator: island classification plus one Gumbo DOM-to-model walker (headings, containers, lists, quotes, details, pre, tables); new element families belong in focused helpers.

Single-binary session lifecycle regression suite; cancellation/self-heal orderings stay cohesive in one deterministic harness; +115 lines for the reading-theme apply/no-op/catch-up/canvas-paper coverage mirroring the fontScale tests.

Cohesive YAML codec regression suite (round-trips, emit shape, migration incl. downgrade re-migration, rejection cases) in one deterministic harness; +1 line for the markdownTheme settings key; +12 lines for the per-tab markdownLandscape boolean (session fixture key plus the bare-boolean emit and hand-edit checks the paper orientation depends on).

Cohesive property-based flowchart-layout regression suite (overlap, monotone columns, column air, routed long edges, fan/chain shape, border anchoring, determinism, page-box fit) reading properties off one measured model per case; +52 lines for the reflow rung that overruns the dimension budget, whose fixture and drawn-within-size check pin that a failed reflow attempt is re-laid-out at its best wrap rather than emitted under an earlier attempt's fit.

Mechanical translator from mupdf/Makefile's own recipe to an MSVC/ninja build: the make -n parser, the flag-translation tables and the ninja emitter must stay beside each other to be auditable as one mapping, and it embeds its emitter as a python heredoc that cannot be split without sourcing a second file at runtime; new build variants belong in focused helpers.
Intentional minimal DIA SDK subset kept local for the EFI diagnostic tool.
Cohesive EFI diagnostic command-line tool.
Cohesive PDB parsing component for the size-analysis tool.
Cohesive table of one JSON builder per PROTOCOL.md intent, mirrored line for line by fixtures/intents.jsonl; the notification intents brought it past 500.
Cohesive fixture suite rebuilding every devices-*, online-* and phone-* snapshot from one shared world of facts; splitting it would duplicate that world.
The service's one dispatch point joining identity, store, views, intents and sessions on one thread, as the Objective-C helper's queue does; areas live in submodules.
Cohesive nearby session lifecycle (accept, dial, race, close) port of SZFriendsNearbyService+Sessions.m; the race and its close paths share private link state.
Cohesive notification decision pass (ADR 0017): store deltas, the never-rules, coalescing and withdrawal share one cursor state; posters live in their own crates.
Cohesive GLib main-loop driver for the C client: callback queue, reconnect watch and dispatch share private state that must not re-enter the library.
Display-free C structs mirroring every PROTOCOL.md view schema field for field; one header so each page reads the same names the schema uses.
The AppKit Friends composer: text view, chips, # picker and drops share one layout and one send path; Attach files, Paste and the `#` and `@` picker wiring live in SZFriendsComposerAttach.m.
Cohesive AppKit Friends settings section: one measured row layout shared by every setting, including Notifications and devices; rows are data, not classes.

The Android plugin's single Tauri command surface (Keystore sealing, Downloads, sharing, settings links, notifications, the document picker for Attach files and files shared from other apps); each command is a thin call into its own helper class. The next addition moves the picker into its own class.
